trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel depth of approximately 55-65 pixels from the lobe apex line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire continuous boundary; characterized by multiple high-amplitude peaks (10-15 pixels) and deep valleys, creating a jagged, non-linear profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit a convex sweep from the medial notch transitioning to a slight concavity toward the distal tips; right lobe (image-left) appears more rounded than the left lobe (image-right).

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense clusters of white, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the dorsal surface of both lobes, appearing as high-contrast scratches against the dark base pigment.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake mark scarring across the dorsal surface and significant irregular tissue erosion/jaggedness along the trailing edge.
